conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I can’t log into my net banking. It says ‘wrong password,’ but I’m sure it’s right!

conversation.text: Yeah, but I don’t get the OTP. What’s going on?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Let’s verify your registered mobile number. Can you confirm it?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s nine nine, six three, seven four, one five, two zero. This is so frustrating!
